# React Native Sync Provider

> React Native Nitro Module for offline-first HTTP sync. Requests are persisted natively (Core Data on iOS, Room on Android), retried with a persisted backoff, and flushed from JS or in OS-scheduled background windows (BGTaskScheduler, WorkManager).

## Package

- npm: @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider
- Repository: https://github.com/gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider
- Documentation: https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-sync-provider/
- Full reference for tools: /llms-full.txt

## Requirements

- React Native >= 0.74.0 (New Architecture / Fabric required)
- React >= 18.2.0
- react-native-nitro-modules ^0.35.6
- Optional peer: @react-native-community/netinfo >= 11.0.0
- Optional peer: react-native-mmkv >= 3.0.0
- Android: minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, Kotlin 2.0+
- iOS: 15+

## Facts that are easy to get wrong

- enqueue stores an item. It does not dispatch it, under any strategy. A flush does, from useAutoSync, flush(), or an OS background window.
- AUTOMATIC means the engine retries failed items on its own. There is no native flush on enqueue or on reconnect.
- Each cycle dispatches one batch of eligible items, up to batchSize (default 25). Use drainUntilEmpty() to loop.
- flush() does not check connectivity. useAutoSync's interval does not either. The native retry timer and drainUntilEmpty() do not flush offline.
- Per-item failures never reject. Read them from ITEM_FAILED events.
- Native error codes do not reach JS through a rejection. A full queue rejects with INVALID_PAYLOAD and no validationErrors, not QUEUE_FULL.
- configureSync replaces the whole configuration and persists it. Omitting defaultHeaders deletes the stored copy.
- Delivery is at least once. The native ULID is not sent with the request: send an Idempotency-Key in headers, built with generateId() before enqueue.
- iOS: the library registers its BGTask handlers itself. Do not call BGTaskScheduler.shared.register for its identifiers.

## Public API — Functions

Queue ops:
- enqueue(item) — Persist one request. Returns the assigned ULID.
- enqueueBatch(items) — Persist several atomically. Returns ULIDs in input order.
- removeItem(id) — Remove one item, in any status.
- clearQueue() — Remove every item, in any status.
- getQueueSize() — PENDING items, cooling ones included.
- getPendingItems() — PENDING items in dispatch order.

Sync ops:
- flush() — Run one cycle. Returns SyncResult.
- drainUntilEmpty(options?) — Flush until empty or a bound stops it. Returns DrainResult.
- cancelDrain() — Hard stop for a running drain.
- pauseSync() — Pause until resumeSync() or the next launch.
- resumeSync() — Resume. Dispatches pending items unless the strategy is MANUAL.
- isSyncing() — true while a cycle is running.

Config ops:
- configureSync(options) — Replace and persist the active SyncOptions.
- getSyncConfig() — Read the active SyncOptions.

History ops:
- getLastSyncResult() — Most recent persisted SyncResult, or undefined.
- getSyncHistory(limit?) — Persisted results, most recent first.
- clearSyncHistory() — Drop persisted history.

Connection:
- getConnectionStatus() — Current ConnectionState snapshot.

Background sync:
- enableBackgroundSync(options) — Schedule OS background work.
- disableBackgroundSync() — Cancel it, including the Android retry kick.
- isBackgroundSyncEnabled() — Reports intent, not OS state.

Events:
- addSyncEventListener(callback) — Subscribe. Returns a subscription id.
- removeSyncEventListener(subscriptionId) — Unsubscribe.

Utilities:
- generateId() — UUID v4 backed by Math.random. For Idempotency-Key headers.
- isNativeModuleAvailable() — true when the native module resolves.

## Public API — React Hooks

- useConnection() — { status, type, isOnline, isMetered }.
- useSyncQueue() — { size, items, isLoading, error, enqueue, enqueueBatch, removeItem, clearQueue, refresh }.
- useSyncStatus() — { isSyncing, isPaused, progress, lastResult, error, flush, pause, resume }.
- useOfflineQueue() — { connection, size, items, isSyncing, isWaitingForConnection, error, enqueue, flush }.
- useSyncEvents({ onEvent, types?, enabled? }) — Subscribe with auto-cleanup.
- useSyncConfig() — { config, isLoading, error, setConfig, refresh }.
- useAutoSync({ enabled, intervalMs?, flushOnReconnect?, flushOnMetered?, flushOnAppForeground? }) — Flush on an interval, on reconnect, and on foreground. Inert unless enabled is true.
- useSyncSnapshot() — Read-only aggregate of connection, queue and sync state.
- useSyncContext() — { config, hasProvider }.

## Context

- SyncProvider — Optional provider. Applies configureSync on mount, and enableBackgroundSync when backgroundSync is passed. Every hook works without it.

## Enums

- SyncStrategy: AUTOMATIC, MANUAL, OPPORTUNISTIC (reserved; behaves like AUTOMATIC)
- SyncPriority: HIGH, NORMAL, LOW
- BackoffStrategy: LINEAR, EXPONENTIAL, FIBONACCI
- HttpMethod: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
- SyncEventType: ITEM_ENQUEUED, ITEM_REMOVED, SYNC_STARTED, SYNC_PROGRESS, SYNC_SUCCEEDED, SYNC_FAILED, ITEM_SUCCEEDED, ITEM_FAILED, ITEM_RETRYING, QUEUE_CLEARED, CONNECTION_CHANGED, PAUSED, RESUMED, BACKGROUND_SYNC_STARTED, BACKGROUND_SYNC_COMPLETED
- ConnectionStatus: CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, METERED, UNKNOWN
- ConnectionType: WIFI, CELLULAR, ETHERNET, BLUETOOTH, VPN, OTHER, NONE, UNKNOWN
- SyncErrorCode: NETWORK_ERROR, SERVER_ERROR, INVALID_PAYLOAD, QUEUE_FULL, NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE, BACKGROUND_TASK_REGISTRATION_FAILED, INVALID_URL, UNAUTHORIZED, TIMEOUT, MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED, DUPLICATE_ITEM, DRAIN_ALREADY_ACTIVE

## Quick Start

```typescript
import {
  SyncProvider,
  useAutoSync,
  useSyncQueue,
  type SyncOptions,
} from '@gabriel-sisjr/react-native-sync-provider';

function Outbox() {
  useAutoSync({ enabled: true, flushOnAppForeground: true });
  const { items, enqueue } = useSyncQueue();

  return (
    <View>
      <Text>Pending: {items.length}</Text>
      <Button
        title="Send event"
        onPress={() =>
          enqueue({
            method: 'POST',
            url: 'https://api.example.com/events',
            contentType: 'application/json',
            body: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'login' }),
          })
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const OPTIONS: SyncOptions = {
  strategy: 'AUTOMATIC',
  retryPolicy: {
    maxAttempts: 5,
    backoff: 'EXPONENTIAL',
    baseDelayMs: 1000,
    maxDelayMs: 60000,
    jitter: true,
    retryOnStatusCodes: [408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
  },
};

export default function App() {
  return (
    <SyncProvider options={OPTIONS}>
      <Outbox />
    </SyncProvider>
  );
}
```

## Key Types

- SyncItemInput — what you enqueue: { method, url, headers?, body?, contentType?, priority?, metadata? }
- SyncItem — SyncItemInput + { id, createdAt, attempts, nextRetryAt }
- SyncOptions — { strategy, retryPolicy, batchSize?, requestTimeoutMs?, maxQueueSize?, persistQueue?, defaultHeaders? }
- RetryPolicy — { maxAttempts, backoff, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs, jitter, retryOnStatusCodes }
- SyncResult — { startedAt, finishedAt, successCount, failureCount, succeededIds, failedIds, errors }
- DrainOptions — { maxIterations?, timeoutMs?, delayBetweenCyclesMs? }
- DrainResult — { iterations, itemsDispatched, queueRemaining, stoppedReason }
- BackgroundSyncOptions — { minimumIntervalMs, requiresCharging?, requiresUnmeteredNetwork?, requiresDeviceIdle?, foregroundOnly?, taskIdentifier? }
- ConnectionState — { status, type, isInternetReachable?, isExpensive? }
- SyncEvent — flat object: { type, timestamp, itemId?, progress?, errorCode?, statusCode?, attempt?, connectionStatus?, metadata? }
- SyncError — Error subclass with .code, .cause?, .validationErrors?
- ValidationIssue — { field, reason, value?, itemIndex? }
